signals.text: Revenue grew 26% a year over 3 years vs 25% over 5: growth is steady.
Profit compounded at 19% vs revenue at 26%: profits are lagging sales.

flags.text: Profit compounded at 19% vs revenue at 26%: profits are lagging sales.

guidance.statement: Deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.

guidance.statement: Add between 18 million to 20 million customers to the franchise in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.

guidance.statement: Deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.
guidance.quote: We remain pretty comfortable place to deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.

guidance.statement: Deliver between 26% and 27% growth on a full year basis in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.

guidance.statement: Maintain medium term AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%.
guidance.quote: So that's the second point. On NIM, clearly, at this point in time... medium term, we maintain a guidance of 20% to 25% on a year lower here and a year higher there.

guidance.statement: End the year with close to 2,800 standalone gold branches.
guidance.quote: and we remain quite clear about ending the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches.

delivered.statement: AUM grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores with net AUM addition of nearly INR 38,000 crores.
PBT grew by 29% to INR 8,537 crores and PAT grew by 29% to INR 6,367 crores.
Booked just below 13.5 million new loans and added 4.5 million new customers.
ROA came in at 4.6%, ROE at 20.6%, and opex to total income improved to 33%.
Net NPA came in at 42 basis points and loan loss to average AUF improved to 1.56%.

calls.tone: Confident on strong secular growth and resilience, cautious on macro/regulatory headwinds.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the short-term gold loan strategy and spike in Stage 2 assets.
Pressed on why such a large capital raise is needed given current leverage and subsidiary stakes.
Questions raised on consumer leverage capacity and rising stress in unsecured segments.
Scepticism on future margin pressures amid rising cost of funds and fee income regulations.

business.summary: A diversified non-banking financial company providing consumer finance, rural finance, MSME lending, mortgages, and commercial lending, generating income through net interest margins and fee-based cross-sell products.

guidance.statement: Foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches (maybe 3,000) for gold loans by year-end.
guidance.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches

guidance.statement: Targeting INR 29,000 crores to INR 31,000 crores organic gold loan AUM by year-end.
guidance.quote: and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.

guidance.statement: Confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement in opex to NTI for FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.

guidance.statement: Digital platform will deliver INR 50,000 crores of business this year and target INR 100,000 crores next year.
guidance.quote: I mean this year the digital platform will deliver INR50,000 crores of business. I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume

guidance.statement: AI, voice and text bots disbursements will reach INR 11,000 crores to INR 12,000 crores for the full year.
guidance.quote: On disbursements, AI, voice and text bots did INR2,500 crores, we will do INR11,000 crores INR12,000 in the full year this year.

delivered.statement: Added 5 million new customers during the quarter.
Added a record INR 37,000 crores of AUM in the quarter.
Profit growth was strong at 28%, with ROE crossing 20% (20.4%) and ROA at 4.7%.
Opex to NTI came in at 33.4%, marginally higher than last year.
Gold loan business grew by 112%, now forming 4% of AUM.
Recognized additional macro provision of INR 296 crores; loan loss to AUF was 1.54%.

calls.tone: confident on robust volume growth and improving credit metrics, maintaining careful balance sheet resilience.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed why strong Q1 results and improving trends have not led to an upward revision in full-year guidance.
Questions raised on capital raising plans given high leverage and upcoming subsidiary dilution.
Scepticism on intense competition in gold loans and potential cannibalization of personal loans.

guidance.statement: We are confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: In terms of AUM, we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years as they begin to scale.

guidance.statement: We expect marginal moderation in NIM, contingent on interest rates.
guidance.quote: NIM, we expect marginal moderation. It's a little bit contingent on how interest rates play out, caused by geopolitical tensions.

guidance.statement: We expect continued improvement in opex to NTI of 25 to 40 basis points.
guidance.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.

guidance.statement: We are confident of adding 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27.
guidance.quote: In terms of customer franchise, we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.

guidance.statement: We continue to guide for ROA of 4.4% to 4.6% in FY27.
guidance.quote: ROA came in as of fourth quarter at 4.6%. We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.

guidance.statement: We continue to guide for return on equity of 19% to 20% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.

delivered.statement: AUM grew by 22.4% year-on-year to cross INR 510,000 crores in Q4 FY26.
PAT grew by 26.7% in Q4 FY26.
Booked 12.9 million loans and added 3.93 million new customers in Q4 FY26.
Cost of funds improved by 4 basis points in Q4 to 7.41%.
ROA came in at 4.6% and ROE at 20% for the fourth quarter.
Full-year loan bookings reached 52.5 million with 17.5 million new customers added.

calls.tone: Confident on demand growth, credit momentum, and AI transformation, while maintaining a cautious stance on macro and geopolitical risks.

pushback.gist: Analysts sought clarification on the revised credit cost metric of 1.45% to 1.60% and recovery adjustments.
Analysts questioned whether NIM expansion is required to achieve the projected ROA guidance for FY27.
Analysts pressed on portfolio cuts and the environment giving confidence in MSME growth revival.
An analyst highlighted undulating returns post-COVID compared to pre-COVID and questioned future compounding sustainability.

guidance.statement: Top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.
guidance.quote: overall, we've taken a view that the top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, but more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.

guidance.statement: Cost of funds is expected to be between 7.55% and 7.60% as we exit the year.
guidance.quote: We're likely to be between 7.55% to 7.60% in terms of cost of funds as we exit the year.

guidance.statement: Expect 17 to 18 million customers to be added to the franchise in FY26.
guidance.quote: We now expect 17 to 18 million customers to be added to the franchise in FY '26.

guidance.statement: Credit cost next year could be anywhere between 165 to 175 basis points.
guidance.quote: We foresee that the number next year as we enter could be anywhere between 165 to 175 basis points, that's the number, including the permanent provisions that we're talking about.

delivered.statement: AUM grew by INR 23,622 crores, with core operating AUM up 22%.
Core profit and PAT both grew by 23%.
Opex to NTI came in at 32.8%.
Net NPA came in at 47 basis points and GNPA at 121 basis points.
New loans booked reached a record 14 million loans in Q3.
Cost of funds came in at 7.45%.

calls.tone: confident on core operational performance and long-term outlook, prudent on balance sheet resilience.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why the permanent ECL and LGD provisioning changes were made now despite global uncertainties.
Pressed on when MSME growth will recover after management deliberately slowed it down.
Inquired how vehicle finance expansion will offset lower ROAs relative to the consolidated business.

guidance.statement: Management hopes that despite grey global clouds, FY2027 will be an excellent year.
guidance.quote: And we hope that despite the grey global clouds, FY2027 will also be an excellent year for your Company.

guidance.statement: Manage 100 million loans annually, reduce operating costs by 50% by FY2030, and increase DIY adoption to 97%.
guidance.quote: This integrated approach is expected to enable management of 100 million loans annually, reduce operations and service costs by 50% by FY2030, increase Do it yourself (DIY) adoption to 97%

guidance.statement: Improve CSAT from 96% to 99% by FY2030.
guidance.quote: and improve CSAT from 96% to 99%

guidance.statement: Scale customer franchise to 200-220 million by FY2030.
guidance.quote: Customer franchise 119.33 MM 200–220 MM

guidance.statement: Scale cross-sell franchise to 120-130 million by FY2030.
guidance.quote: Cross-sell franchise 75.51 MM 120–130 MM

guidance.statement: Achieve Return on Equity of 19% to 21% by FY2030.
guidance.quote: Return on equity 18.1% 19%–21%

delivered.statement: Bajaj Broking customer franchise grew by 41% to over 1.38 million in FY2026.
Bajaj Broking PAT rose by 46% to C 203 crore in FY2026.
Gold loan AUM grew by 115% to C 17,831 crore in FY2026.
Rural Lending AUM grew by 27% to C 35,793 crore in FY2026.
Consolidated gross NPA stood at 1.01% and net NPA improved to 0.41% as of March 31, 2026.
Overall home loans AUM grew by 18% year-on-year to reach C 76,055 crore as of March 31, 2026.

calls.tone: Optimistic, ambitious, and focused on digital transformation and AI integration for future growth.

business.summary: Bajaj Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company engaged in lending, wealth advisory, and financial services, offering consumer, rural, SME, and mortgage loans alongside payment and broking solutions.

bull.point: PAT grew by 28.7% YoY in Sep 2026 to INR 6,367 crores with strong ROE of 20.6% and ROA of 4.6%.
Urban consumer finance grew by 43%, rural consumer finance by 63%, and overall AUM rose 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores.
Gold loan portfolio reached INR 24,000+ crores, with organic AUM scaling rapidly and 2,800 standalone gold branches targeted.

bear.point: Long-term profit compounded at 19% lagging revenue growth of 26%, showing pressure on bottom-line sales conversion.
